scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man in cream and terracotta robes sits in a sunlit stone courtyard, looking upward with one hand on a tied scroll. Olive branches, flowering vines and clay jars frame a distant intact walled coastal town, fields, palms and blue sea.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: Jeremiah's attentive pose imagines his receiving the LORD's word. The intact distant town evokes Gaza before Pharaoh's attack. The courtyard, viewpoint, clothing and scroll are imaginative details; the verse does not locate Jeremiah at Gaza or say he witnessed the attack. God is not depicted.
